svg.text: A KDE Plasma 6 rice for my Fedora machine, in the same cassette palette as
this page: amber CRT in dark mode, rust on warm beige in light mode. Two color
schemes and two Global Themes that switch colors, wallpaper, icons and cursor
in one go, monochrome icons that invert themselves per background, an amber
Bibata cursor, Space Mono and VT323, a Konsole profile and flat window
borders. A thin top bar with an audio visualizer, plus QML widgets I wrote: a
date readout that themes itself off the active color scheme and an optional
slow wireframe globe. One install.sh, no root needed. The wallpapers are third
party images from Wallhaven, so check their sources before reusing them.
